location.en: Front desk of a police station

goal.en: Report your lost wallet and find out what to do next.
goal.zh: 通報錢包遺失，並問清楚接下來該怎麼做。

background: quiet small police station lobby, long wooden front counter with a stack of blank forms and a pen holder, plastic chairs along a pale blue wall, bright overhead lights

intro.en: On your way home, you reach into your bag. Your wallet is gone.
intro.zh: 回家路上，你把手伸進包包。錢包不見了。

intro.en: You search everywhere twice, then walk to the nearest police station.
intro.zh: 你上上下下找了兩遍，只好走到最近的警察局。

lines.en: Good afternoon. What can I do for you?
lines.zh: 午安。有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

choices.en: Hi. I'd like to report a lost wallet, please.
choices.tip: I'd like to report a lost... 冷靜說明來意，對方馬上知道要辦遺失登記。

choices.en: My wallet dropped. I want to report a case.
choices.zh: 我的錢包掉了。我要報案。

lines.en: A case? Was there a crime? Did someone take it from you?
lines.zh: 案件？發生犯罪了嗎？有人搶走你的錢包嗎？

story.en: Officer Santos starts a robbery report. Twenty minutes in, you finally realize what's happening.
story.zh: 桑托斯警員開始填搶案報告。二十分鐘後，你才發現事情不太對勁。

fail.why: 「報案」直譯成 report a case，聽起來像要報刑案。遺失東西說 I'd like to report a lost wallet. 或 I lost my wallet.

choices.en: Someone stole my wallet! Go find the thief right now!
choices.zh: 有人偷了我的錢包！快去把小偷抓到！

lines.en: Okay, slow down. Did you actually see someone take it?
lines.zh: 好，先冷靜。你真的有看到人拿走嗎？

story.en: You didn't. You spend an hour answering questions about a thief who may not even exist.
story.zh: 你沒看到。結果你花了一個小時，回答關於一個可能根本不存在的小偷的問題。

fail.why: 沒看到人偷就大喊被偷，還命令警察馬上抓人，既不正確也很衝。冷靜說明：I'd like to report a lost wallet.

lines.en: Sorry to hear that. Let's fill out a report.
lines.zh: 很遺憾。我們來填一份報告。

lines.en: Where and when did you last see it?
lines.zh: 你最後一次看到它是在哪裡、什麼時候？

choices.en: I last saw it at a café on Pine Street, around noon.
choices.zh: 我最後一次看到是在松樹街的咖啡店，大概中午。
choices.tip: I last saw it at... around... 地點加時間，一句話就把警察要的資訊給齊了。

choices.en: I last see it in café on Pine Street at twelve.
choices.zh: 我最後看到它在松樹街的咖啡店，十二點。

lines.en: You see it there? So it's at the café right now?
lines.zh: 你看到它在那裡？所以錢包現在在咖啡店？

story.en: Officer Santos writes "wallet located" and closes the report. It takes a second trip to the station to reopen it.
story.zh: 桑托斯警員寫下「錢包已尋獲」就結案了。你得再跑一趟警察局才能重新登記。

fail.why: 「最後一次看到」是過去的事，要用過去式 saw：I last saw it at a café. 用 see 聽起來像你現在還看得到它。

choices.en: It's a brown leather wallet, kind of old, with a small zipper.
choices.zh: 是一個咖啡色皮夾，有點舊，有一個小拉鍊。

lines.en: Good to know. But where did you last have it?
lines.zh: 了解。不過你最後一次拿著它是在哪裡？

story.en: You describe every scratch on the wallet. By the time you mention the café, it has already closed for the day.
story.zh: 你把錢包上每一道刮痕都描述了一遍。等你終於提到咖啡店，店家已經打烊了。

fail.why: 對方問的是在哪裡、什麼時候最後看到，不是錢包長什麼樣子。先回答問題：I last saw it at a café, around noon.

lines.en: Got it. Was there anything important inside? Cards, ID, cash?
lines.zh: 了解。裡面有重要的東西嗎？卡片、證件、現金？

choices.en: Yes, my bank card, student ID and about forty dollars in cash.
choices.zh: 有，我的金融卡、學生證，還有大約四十元現金。
choices.tip: 直接列出物品清單，用 and 連接最後一項，簡單又完整。

choices.en: Yes. Inside has my bank card, my student card and forty dollars.
choices.zh: 有。裡面有我的金融卡、學生證和四十元。

lines.en: Inside has...? Sorry, inside what? Is there another bag?
lines.zh: 裡面有……？抱歉，什麼裡面？還有另一個包包嗎？

story.en: Officer Santos adds "second bag, missing" to the report. Now the police are looking for two things you didn't lose.
story.zh: 桑托斯警員在報告上加了「另一個包包，遺失」。現在警方在找兩樣東西，其中一樣你根本沒掉。

fail.why: 「裡面有……」不能直譯成 Inside has...。可以說 There was... in it.，或直接列出物品：my bank card, student ID and some cash.

choices.en: Of course! Why else would I be here? Everything is in there!
choices.zh: 當然有啊！不然我來這裡幹嘛？所有東西都在裡面！

lines.en: I'm just doing my job. I need the details.
lines.zh: 我只是在做我的工作。我需要細節。

story.en: Officer Santos finishes the report in silence. Every answer to your questions is one word long.
story.zh: 桑托斯警員默默把報告打完。之後你問什麼，她都只回一個字。

fail.why: 警察照流程問細節，不是在懷疑你。照實回答就好：Yes, my bank card, student ID and some cash.

lines.en: All right, your report is done. Here's your case number.
lines.zh: 好，報告完成了。這是你的案件編號。

lines.en: If someone turns it in, we'll give you a call.
lines.zh: 如果有人送回來，我們會打電話通知你。

choices.en: Thank you. What should I do next? Should I cancel my bank card?
choices.zh: 謝謝。我接下來該做什麼？要先停掉金融卡嗎？
choices.tip: What should I do next? 讓對方告訴你完整步驟，再具體問最擔心的事。

choices.en: Can you check the street cameras? In Taiwan, police do that fast.
choices.zh: 你們可以調路口監視器嗎？在台灣警察很快就會調。

lines.en: Cameras? For a lost wallet? Sorry, we don't do that for lost items.
lines.zh: 監視器？為了一個遺失的錢包？抱歉，遺失物我們不調監視器。

story.en: You keep asking about cameras until Officer Santos has to take another call. You leave with no idea what to do next.
story.zh: 你一直追問監視器，直到桑托斯警員得去接另一通電話。你離開時，完全不知道下一步該做什麼。

fail.why: 在台灣常聽說警察會幫忙調監視器找東西，但在很多英語國家，遺失物通常只做紀錄。問清楚下一步：What should I do next?

choices.en: Okay, thank you. I will wait you call me when you find it.
choices.zh: 好，謝謝。我會等你找到的時候打給我。

lines.en: Wait, you'll call me? Okay... sure, call anytime.
lines.zh: 等等，是你要打給我？好……可以，隨時打來。

story.en: Officer Santos waits for your call, and you wait for hers. Your wallet sits at the café for a week before anyone tells you.
story.zh: 桑托斯警員等你打來，你等她打來。你的錢包在咖啡店放了一個禮拜，才有人通知你。

fail.why: 「等你打給我」要說 I'll wait for your call. 或 Please call me if you find it. wait 後面少了 for，句子結構一亂，對方可能以為是你要打給她。

lines.en: Good thinking. Call your bank right away, and check with the café too.
lines.zh: 想得很周到。馬上打給銀行，也去咖啡店問問看。

lines.en: That evening, the café calls. Someone found your wallet under a table.
lines.zh: 那天傍晚，咖啡店打電話來。有人在桌子底下撿到你的錢包。

story.en: Your card is already canceled, but everything else is there, even the forty dollars. You bring the café staff a box of cookies to say thanks.
story.zh: 你的卡已經停用了，但其他東西都還在，連四十元也沒少。你帶了一盒餅乾去咖啡店答謝店員。

notes.en: I'd like to report a lost...
notes.explain: report a lost wallet / phone / passport 用在通報遺失；如果確定是被偷，才說 report a theft。

example.en: I'd like to report a lost passport.

notes.explain: last 放在動詞前面，動詞用過去式，後面接地點和時間。

example.en: I last saw my keys on the kitchen table.
example.zh: 我最後一次看到鑰匙是在廚房桌上。

notes.explain: 遇到不熟悉的流程時，這句能讓對方把完整步驟告訴你，比自己亂猜可靠。

example.en: My phone is gone. What should I do next?
example.zh: 我的手機不見了。接下來我該怎麼辦？

notes.explain: My wallet dropped. 只是「錢包掉到地上」。「弄丟了」要說 I lost my wallet. 或 My wallet is missing.

example.en: I lost my wallet. I think I dropped it on the bus.
example.zh: 我的錢包弄丟了，應該是掉在公車上。

notes.explain: 在楓灣掉東西，記得回頭問店家或車站的 lost and found，很多東西是被好心人交給店家。到警察局報案主要是留下紀錄。

example.en: Excuse me, do you have a lost and found?
example.zh: 不好意思，你們有失物招領處嗎？
